allow: PowerShell($pid = \(Get-Process trainer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Id; "trainer PID = $pid"; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -OwningProcess $pid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -ge 28700 -and $_.LocalPort -lt 28720 } | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess)

PowerShell($tp = \(Get-Process trainer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Id; "trainer PID\(s\) = $tp"; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.OwningProcess -in @\($tp\) } | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell($t = Get-Process trainer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($t\) { "ALIVE PID " + $t.Id + " uptime\(s\)=" + [math]::Round\(\(\(Get-Date\)-$t.StartTime\).TotalSeconds,0\) } else { "NOT running" })

PowerShell(try { $v = gh --version 2>$null; if \($v\) { "gh: " + \($v | Select-Object -First 1\) } else { "gh: not found" } } catch { "gh: not found" }; "--- git credential manager ---"; git config --get credential.helper)
